question: How long does an end-to-end SDPB reproduction take at the accuracy the paper's claims actually need?

earlier_wrong_estimate.why_wrong: stacked three pessimistic and unnecessary assumptions: the full 1500-disk set, the full N=1779 basis, and ~200 iterations to a duality gap (1e-15/1e-30) no claim in the paper uses.

the_paper_s_tolerance.implication: a relative duality gap of 1e-3 leaves a factor 20 on the tightest band

measured.fit: gap falls x0.8842 per iteration, 45-iteration fit at M=20

four_measured_levers.lever: rebuild the basis on the imposed rows only: N 1779 -> 795

four_measured_levers.why_safe: Schur condition ~6e34 ~ 2^116; 192 bits ~ 57 digits leaves ~22 of margin

parallelism: The right level is ACROSS independent solves -- every boundary direction and every representative point is independent, so 100 nodes give 100x with no MPI efficiency question at all.  Whether SDPB's own MPI helps within one solve is a separate and smaller question; the earlier -n 1/4/16 measurement was taken while the shared machine was at load 132 and is being redone.
